title: Telepathic interview with a live ET at S4

tellings.quote: And he said he saw the ET guy, but he was like, you know, five and a half feet tall.

plain: A guest named Danny Sheehan tells podcast host Jesse Michels what a man named Oscar Wolf told him about S4, said to be a secret site near Area 51, a guarded military base in the Nevada desert. According to Sheehan, Wolf said he saw a living extraterrestrial there, about five and a half feet tall, and the story's framing is that it was interviewed by telepathy, which would mean the government holds live beings from elsewhere.
